<mxfile host="make-drawio-svg" type="device"><diagram id="page-1" name="Verify discovery, activation, and output separately"><mxGraphModel dx="800" dy="600" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1100" pageHeight="330" math="0" shadow="0"><root><mxCell id="0" /><mxCell id="1" parent="0" /><mxCell id="discovery" value="01 DISCOVER
Skill metadata
is visible" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#eaf2ff;strokeColor=#6b96cf;fontColor=#20334b;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=28;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="20" y="80" width="235" height="135" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="invocation" value="02 SELECT
Explicit request
or relevance" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f1ebfb;strokeColor=#9b7ac3;fontColor=#20334b;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=28;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="295" y="80" width="235" height="135" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="execution" value="03 EXECUTE
Body + needed
resources" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff3db;strokeColor=#c59b4f;fontColor=#20334b;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=28;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="570" y="80" width="235" height="135" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="verification" value="04 VERIFY
Facts, caveats
+ input integrity" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#e6f4ec;strokeColor=#68a485;fontColor=#20334b;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=26;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="845" y="80" width="235" height="135" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="caption" value="Installed is not the same as enabled, selected, or successfully executed." style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=none;strokeColor=none;fontColor=#20334b;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=24;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="20" y="255" width="1060" height="55" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="e1" value="" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;strokeWidth=2;" edge="1" parent="1" source="discovery" target="invocation"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="e2" value="" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;strokeWidth=2;" edge="1" parent="1" source="invocation" target="execution"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="e3" value="" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;strokeWidth=2;" edge="1" parent="1" source="execution" target="verification"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /></mxCell></root></mxGraphModel></diagram></mxfile>
svg.title: Verify discovery, activation, and output separately
svg.desc: Skill metadata must be discovered before invocation. Explicit invocation or relevance-based selection loads the skill body; permissions and tools determine execution. A measured result, not installation or a hook message, is evidence that the intended workflow ran.

text.tspan: Installed is not the same as enabled, selected, or successfully executed.
